service_boundary: Represents customer-created Inference Endpoints, not Inference Providers routing, the Hub repository alone, Spaces, or self-hosted inference engines.
regional_controls: Customers choose among documented AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud regions and instance types; private connectivity support is provider- and region-specific.
retention_controls: Hugging Face states it does not store endpoint request payloads or tokens and retains service logs for 30 days. Uploaded model repositories and deployment resources remain stored customer assets.
routing: Traffic targets a customer-created endpoint and its autoscaling replicas rather than an external provider-selection layer.
customization: Customers choose model repositories, revisions, inference engines, containers, hardware, scaling, and custom handlers.
strengths: Dedicated model deployments combine Hub artifacts with managed infrastructure and autoscaling.
Cloud, region, hardware, access, and private-network choices are explicit.
tradeoffs: Customers retain more deployment and model-compatibility responsibility than serverless catalogs.
Available regions and private connectivity differ by underlying cloud.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints security page, for Hugging Face Inference Endpoints

upstream_disclosure.note: The security page states how the operator handles content: "Hugging Face does not store any customer data in terms of payloads or tokens that are passed to the Inference Endpoint." The operator runs the dedicated deployment; no subprocessor is named on that page.
upstream_disclosure.scope: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints security page, for Hugging Face Inference Endpoints

credential_handling.note: The service offers no customer-supplied upstream-key path: an endpoint is called with a Hugging Face token ("Private (default): Accessible only to you, or members of your Hugging Face organization, using a personal HF access token.") and serves a model the customer deploys.
credential_handling.scope: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints configuration guide, for Hugging Face Inference Endpoints

cache_isolation.note: Each endpoint is a dedicated deployment, but no page states how a prefix cache is scoped; the serving engine's documentation says only that with several replicas "the cache will not be present, meaning no speed benefit."
cache_isolation.scope: Text Generation Inference chunking documentation, read for Hugging Face Inference Endpoints

vulnerability_disclosure.note: A security.txt file is published with a contact address ("Contact: security@huggingface.co").
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Hugging Face security.txt, for Hugging Face Inference Endpoints

independent_audit.note: The security page names the service: "The Hugging Face Hub, and Inference Endpoints, is SOC2 Type 2 certified."
independent_audit.scope: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints security page, for Hugging Face Inference Endpoints
